presentations.title: Data foundations & first detection results

Present the reference dataset, split definition and preprocessing workflow scheduled for completion in week 3.

Outline the XAI method-selection criteria and show progress on the initial web interface.

presentations.title: Classification & emerging quantification
expectations: Report concentration-classification findings and compare them with the earlier detection results.
Introduce the regression setup and preliminary findings; regression continues into week 6.
Summarise measurement coverage, labelling progress and unresolved data-quality issues.
Show the first explanation examples, where available, and progress on pipeline integration.

presentations.title: Reference models & local-data readiness

presentations.title: Adaptation to local measurements
expectations: Report the local-data detection adaptation scheduled to finish in week 10.

presentations.title: Evaluation, explanations & integration
expectations: Summarise the adapted detection, classification and regression pipelines completed through week 11.

presentations.title: Consolidated findings & final checks
expectations: Present the completed local-data evaluation and comparison, stating the scope and limitations of each claim.
Show progress on explanation faithfulness and stability testing, with remaining week 15 work clearly identified.
Demonstrate the integrated interface and report end-to-end test findings and unresolved defects.
Summarise achieved outputs, open risks, documentation status and the remaining week 15 actions.
presentations.evidence: Evaluation report, explanation-test evidence, end-to-end test summary, interface demonstration and a close-out task list.

risks.title: Local measurements arrive late
risks.trigger: Measurement access, materials or preparation delays leave the planned local dataset incomplete.
risks.impact: Local-data preparation and adaptation may not start at the scheduled time.
risks.mitigation: Review acquisition readiness at each presentation and coordinate the measurement plan with local-data preparation.
risks.fallback: Continue the reference-data work and document the unavailable local-data evaluation. Agree any revised scope or schedule with supervisors.

risks.title: Measurement quality or labels are inconsistent
risks.trigger: Missing metadata, inconsistent labels or visibly unstable measurements appear during quality control.
risks.impact: Unreliable inputs can invalidate model development and subsequent comparisons.
risks.mitigation: Keep acquisition metadata with each measurement and use a documented quality-control and labelling review.
risks.fallback: Quarantine questionable records without altering raw sources; repeat measurements where feasible and report the resulting coverage limits.

risks.title: Data leakage compromises evaluation
risks.trigger: Related measurements cross split boundaries or preprocessing is fitted using evaluation data.
risks.mitigation: Review the intended independent unit and split assignments before training; fit learned preprocessing on the training partition only.
risks.fallback: Recreate affected splits or pipelines under the approved protocol, rerun affected experiments and label superseded results explicitly.

risks.title: Model performance is weak or unstable
risks.trigger: Validation performance varies markedly across the planned runs or fails to improve on the baseline.
risks.impact: Model selection becomes unreliable and useful predictive performance remains uncertain.
risks.mitigation: Compare models on the same approved evaluation protocol and inspect task-specific errors and data coverage.
risks.fallback: Retain the most defensible baseline, report limitations and seek supervisor agreement before changing targets, models or scope.

risks.title: Reference and local data differ
risks.trigger: Local signal patterns, acquisition conditions or label ranges differ from the reference dataset.
risks.impact: A reference-data pipeline may not perform reliably on local measurements.
risks.mitigation: Document acquisition and target differences; keep reference-data and local-data evaluation results distinguishable.
risks.fallback: Report the local adaptation findings separately and qualify unsupported transfer claims. Agree any further acquisition or adaptation work with supervisors.

risks.title: Explanations lack stability or support
risks.trigger: Explanations change substantially under planned checks or do not support the stated interpretation.
risks.impact: Model explanations may be misleading or difficult to defend in a presentation.
risks.mitigation: Document the explanation method and evaluate faithfulness and stability before making interpretive claims.
risks.fallback: Present inconclusive findings explicitly and restrict conclusions to supported observations; revise the explanation approach with supervisor input.

risks.title: The interface misrepresents model outputs
risks.trigger: Displayed values, units, labels or sample identifiers disagree with saved reference outputs.
risks.impact: A demonstration can show incorrect results despite a valid modelling pipeline.
risks.mitigation: Compare the interface with recorded outputs and test the complete data-to-display path before presentations.
risks.fallback: Use a verified table-and-plot view or a documented recorded demonstration while integration defects are resolved.

risks.title: Result queries produce unsupported answers
risks.trigger: A query response cites unavailable results or misstates the contents of a recorded experiment.
risks.impact: The query interface may communicate claims that the project evidence does not support.
risks.mitigation: Limit queries to recorded project results, retain their source identifiers and test missing-result questions.
risks.fallback: Disable unsupported query behaviour and use direct access to verified result tables until the issue is resolved.
